TEXT.English: Tiles already producing at least 5 commerce gain +1 commerce; trade routes produce +25% commerce. Recon, Archery, Mounted, and Melee units receive Road of the Sun, granting double movement on Hills. Huayna Workers and Settlers also receive Road of the Sun, so they move twice as fast on Hills.
